title: A planned repro or check that plants an extender at one signature breaks the landing of a later item that changes how the point is called
goal: planning orders items that share an extension point by their repros' planted shapes: a repro plants the shape the point documents (every optional parameter included), or the later item's checks name the earlier item's repro as one to rerun

run:

sys.exit('not yet: plan section lacks '+', '.join(miss) if miss else 0)
